title: Replace dotenv with Bun-native env — remove .env dependency
description: The .env file contains a real GitHub PAT and is in the working tree, but .gitignore properly excludes it and `git log --all -- .env` confirms it was never committed to git history. However, the code uses `dotenv` to load from `.env` (src/index.ts:126, scripts/set-folder-dates.ts:59) which is unnecessary — Bun auto-loads environment variables. The dotenv dependency adds weight and .env file management is unnecessary when the user can simply `export GITHUB_TOKEN=...` or set it inline.
spec:
1. Delete the .env file from the working tree (it is gitignored, so no git history impact).
2. Replace the dotenv dependency with a Bun-native approach: read GITHUB_TOKEN from `process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN` directly (Bun auto-loads env vars, or the user can `export GITHUB_TOKEN=...` before running the tool).
3. Update README.md to instruct users to set the GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable via their shell profile or inline `GITHUB_TOKEN=xxx bun run sync`.
4. Remove the `dotenv` dependency from package.json and the `import { config as loadDotenv } from 'dotenv'` from both src/index.ts and scripts/set-folder-dates.ts.
5. Remove the `loadDotenv()` calls from src/index.ts:126 and scripts/set-folder-dates.ts:59.
6. Run `bun run smoke:qc` to verify.
